summary: First test run. Backend pytest (7/7 passed) covers config, validation, invalid Frame.io URL graceful fail, full upload+OCR+Gemini pipeline, list with issue_count, manual post 400 without asset, and delete. Frontend Playwright covers landing/config badge=Connected, upload+submit, polling /analysis/:id through extracting->analyzing->done states, progress updates, history page with rows, navigation Home<->History, and validation toast for empty submit. End-to-end Gemini 3 Flash OCR worked — extracted 'Helo Wrld tset' and produced 10 spelling/grammar suggestions in ~20s.

ui_bugs.issue: Frames captured at timestamp 0s are labeled 'Script' instead of '0s' because formatTime returns '—' for sec<=0 and the label uses timestamp_sec>0. Misleading: OCR issues from the first frame look like transcript-derived issues.

action_items: (Optional) Treat OCR frame timestamps of 0 distinctly from transcript issues in the UI label (e.g., show '0s' for frame 0 and 'Script' only when source is the transcript pass).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses Analysis.model_fields['updated_at'].default_factory() in _save/_set_status — works but brittle; prefer datetime.utcnow() or a helper.
_run_pipeline downloads, extracts and analyzes sequentially with no per-frame timeout/retry; a single slow Gemini call could stall the whole job.
Uploaded video temp dir (tmpdir from create_analysis) is never cleaned up after _run_pipeline — only workdir is removed.
post_comment results aren't surfaced in the API response on errors (only ok flag stored implicitly); consider logging failure reasons per-issue.
test_credentials: Not applicable - no auth in app.
seed_data_creation: Generated /tmp/test.mp4 (and /tmp/ui_test.mp4) via ffmpeg drawtext with intentional typos. Test analyses are cleaned up by the delete test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pipeline e2e validated. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY + FRAMEIO_TOKEN already in backend/.env. ffmpeg at /usr/bin/ffmpeg. For Frame.io auto-post you'd need a real Frame.io asset URL; uploaded-video path skips posting (verified posted_count=0).
